regulation (new severity table):
Assess the safety level of the scene into one of four categories:
   - Level one: High-risk hazards present that could lead to severe incidents;
   - Level two: Moderate risks present that may cause safety issues or violations;
   - Level three: Minor hazards present that require attention but are not urgent;
   - no abnormalities observed: No obvious abnormalities or risk factors.
